subject: Game Theory
title: Winner-Take-All Markets
description: A fast breakdown of Winner-Take-All Markets for builders.

hook.text: Google has 90% of search. Facebook has 75% of social media. Why do these markets tip to one winner?

buildup.text: Strong network effects create positive feedback: more users attract more users, pushing one firm ahead.

discovery.text: Once a platform leads, switching costs trap users. Your friends are on Facebook, not on the alternative.

twist.text: Winner-take-all isn't inevitable. Uber and Lyft coexist because switching costs for riders are low.

climax.text: The key factor: can users multi-home (use both platforms) or must they commit to one?

quiz.question: What enables winner-take-all outcomes?
options: Strong network effects and high switching costs
